title: SCA Tish'a BeAb 2022: Mrs. Vivien Hidary

chapters.title: Introduction and the prophecy of Zechariah
Mastery of desires and the story of Gan Eden
The aftermath of the sin and the question of Ayeka
The internal and external self
chapters.about: Anohi, disconnect, internal self, external self

chapters.title: Yom Kippur and the concept of covering

summary: Mrs. Hidary explores the concept of rebuilding the Bet HaMikdash by focusing on internal personal growth and the mastery of one's desires. She examines the story of Adam and Hava in Gan Eden to illustrate the disconnect between our external and internal selves and encourages sincerity as a path toward wholeness. By aligning our inner divine self with our outer actions, she suggests we can move toward a state of personal and national redemption.
questions: Why do we fast on Tish'a BeAb if we want to rebuild the Bet HaMikdash?
What does the question 'Ayeka' mean in the context of our own lives?
How can we bridge the gap between our internal and external selves?
What does it mean to be sincere in our service to Hashem?
How does the story of Adam and Hava relate to our current state of exile?
